text:
Maria: Quick sync 1 2: we need final social plan for May 6 webinar (benchmark + launch narrative). X and LinkedIn top priority. Who owns copy + assets?

Lucas: I can draft X thread + short X posts. Need hero GIF (1200x628), square image (800x800), and a 30s clip.

Ben: I'll wire up landing UTMs and two CTA variants. Suggest: utm_campaign=may6_bench&utm_medium=social. Will share exact links.

Emily: Scheduler ready. Need final copy by Tue 5pm PT to queue. Can enable boosted slot for LinkedIn if approved.

Ravi: SDR coverage: Ill handle replies for 1h post each publish. Please send webhook to #inbound-sdr and include utm_term=webinar in CTAs.

Lucas: Draft schedule (PT):
- May 6 12:00 1: LinkedIn long post (hero image)
- May 6 12:05 1: X main + thread
- May 6 15:00 1: X highlight repost

Lucas: Draft copy (short):
LinkedIn: "New benchmark: 3x throughput + 40% lower per-token cost. Join our May 6 webinar to see methodology & live Q&A. Register (no-cost): <link>"
X first tweet: "Benchmarks out: same model, 40% lower per-token cost. See how we did it on May 6 1: Register: <link>"
X thread opener: "Why the cost drop? Smart routing + caching. Full breakdown May 6."

Maria: Nice. Two quick edits: 1) change 'free' to 'no-cost' per legal; 2) put the registration CTA at the end of the LinkedIn post.

Lucas: Edits done and uploaded assets: hero_v4.gif, hero_square_v2.png, clip_30s.mp4.

Ben: CTAs: A) Register now 0: seats limited B) Join live + get benchmark PDF. UTM example: https://redwood.com/webinar?utm_campaign=may6_bench&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_content=ctaA

Emily: Queued the posts (pending approval). Preview: https://scheduler.redwood/preview/4012 (LinkedIn) https://scheduler.redwood/preview/4013 (X). Boost slot set to 12:30 PT on LinkedIn pending budget sign-off.

LaunchBot: Calendar event "May 6 Webinar 1: Social Push" created. Owner: Maria. Reminders set. :calendar:

Ravi: I'll drop a 3-line canned SDR reply w/ Calendly and the benchmark PDF link. Will post to #inbound-sdr 10m before first post.

Ben: After publish I'll push UTMs and conversion tags to analytics and validate tracking. Will flag mismatches.

Emily: Approved by Maria. Going live May 6. I'll enable engagement alerts and route mentions to #marketing-watch for 2h after publish.

Maria: Thanks team. Please post any early engagement highlights here and I'll compile top signals 30m after launch.
